events.title: Ashigaru Tactics is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Ashigaru Tactics is part of Steam Next Fest from Oct 19 to 26. Lead a band of mercenaries through Sengoku-era Japan: farmers, monks, militia and ronin, hired for contracts in a land torn apart by clan wars, bandits, and rumours of yokai. The battles are turn-based on hexes, with 150+ perks and permadeath. The demo is the full game until release. events.title: Update v66 — Clan Wars
events.summary: Update v66 — Clan Wars Clan disputes can now grow into wars fought across the map. Clans establish forward camps, send patrols and supplies, lose territory, and offer new wartime contracts. Clan Wars Added formal clan wars that grow from prolonged disputes and aggression. Clans now launch scouts, patrols, raids, war parties, and supply columns across active fronts. events.title: Update v64 — Youkai on the Roads
events.summary: Update v64 — Youkai on the Roads Stories once dismissed as roadside folklore are becoming harder to ignore. This update adds a broad youkai roster, new contracts, more varied world activity, and additional controls for new campaigns. Youkai Expanded the youkai threat with Gaki, Onibi, Tengu, Kamaitachi, Yuki-onna, Ushi-oni, Yato-no-kami, and stronger Oni. events.title: Update v59 — Raids, Clan Skirmishes & Roadside Encounters
events.summary: Update v59 — Raids, Clan Skirmishes & Roadside Encounters This update expands what you can do across the world: raid town holdings, defend or repair them, take work from clans, and meet travelers with more to offer than a fight. Raids and Town Defenses Raid farms, fisheries, and other town holdings for supplies and loot. Damaged holdings hurt their town’s economy until repaired. events.title: Update v58
events.summary: Update v58 Sorry, the balance was bad last patch. The early game became much more brutal than intended, with sudden difficulty spikes and contracts that did not always reflect the danger involved. This update focuses on correcting those problems. Balance Slower enemy scaling in the early game. Enemy parties now grow more smoothly in both size and quality, with fewer sudden jumps to much stronger units.
